result.reason: The clause provides up to six months of transition assistance and machine-readable data return, but it does not require data export within 30 days or certification of deletion thereafter. It also applies only upon termination or expiry of Maintenance Services rather than expiry or termination of the Agreement, and uses Schedule A rates instead of then-current rates. Requiring return at Garman's cost is an unnecessary commercial addition. The drafting is generally clear but does not fully reach even the fallback because the 30-day export deadline is missing.
